stem.text: Solutions $P$ and $Q$ each contain a different Group 2 ion at the same concentration. One contains $\text{Mg}^{2+}$, the other contains $\text{Ba}^{2+}$. Tests are carried out on separate $5\,\text{cm}^{3}$ samples of $P$ and $Q$.
What are the results of these tests?

A.text: more precipitate with $\text{Ba}^{2+}$; more precipitate with $\text{Ba}^{2+}$

B.text: more precipitate with $\text{Ba}^{2+}$; more precipitate with $\text{Mg}^{2+}$

C.text: more precipitate with $\text{Mg}^{2+}$; more precipitate with $\text{Ba}^{2+}$

D.text: more precipitate with $\text{Mg}^{2+}$; more precipitate with $\text{Mg}^{2+}$
